g.text: Two-Dimensional Thermo-Hydro-Mechanical Evolution of Early Planetesimals
• Basic nodes (Nx, Ny): shear stress σxy, viscosity η
• Cell centers (Nx-1, Ny-1): normal stress, P, T, φ
• Staggered faces: velocities vx, vy and Darcy flux qx, qy
• Particles distributed in rock, core, & sticky air
• Tracks phase tm, melt fraction Fm, metal Xfe
• Initializes volatile mass fractions: H, C, N, S
• Evaluates Courant condition on matrix & Darcy flow
• Subcycles metal segregation CFL: Nsub ≤ Nmax
• Clamps max growth rate: dt ≤ min(dt_max, 1.2·dt_prev)
• Flared disk irradiation & Class 0/I/II viscous heating
• Gas envelope capture & Guillot greenhouse atmosphere
• Short-lived radionuclides: ²⁶Al (0.717 Ma) & ⁶⁰Fe (2.62 Ma)
• Accretion impact shock heating on outer shells
• Local marker replenishment in depleted cells
• Cold surface venting & ice cold-trap clamping
• Invariant resolution: dx = const, odd-parity remapping
• Terminates when t ≥ t_end or maximum steps reached
• Zero numerical diffusion on moving boundaries via Lagrangian markers
